How research and factchecking work at Kurzgesagt
Kurzgesagt ist proud to be one of the biggest science channels on YouTube. But what does the most sciency part of our work — research — actually look like? My name is <PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_PERSON>, I joined Kurzgesagt in 2016 as a researcher and am now leading the editorial team as Head of Research. Let’s take a tour of our editorial department and look at what we do here, how we do it — but especially why!

Science provides the foundation for all our content, so almost every project, no matter if video, print or interactive, includes an early research stage and passes through the editorial and research team. Currently this team consists of six full-time employees: a head of research, two fact checkers, two researchers and scriptwriters and one social media editor. Our specific tasks vary, but in principle we all work together to make sure what Kurzgesagt puts out is scientifically reliable and of high quality.

YouTube is the core of our brand, so I will mainly focus on this example here. Similar steps apply to our product and interactive process and in a more condensed way to TikTok and social media in general though.

For our YouTube videos, research usually happens in one of two ways: either as an in-depth research or as an intense vetting process.

Research

In the first case, our inhouse research serves as a jumping-off point for script-writing. An in-house researcher is asked to find out everything interesting there is about a topic and put it in a document. This assignment is the gate way for a deep dive and helps to decide if a topic will be turned into a video. We often start out with simply reading the Wikipedia article just to get a very basic understanding and continue with reading primary sources like scientific papers, meta analyses and sometimes whole books. We extract all the prime information, the juicy facts, links, tables, graphs, interesting and relevant quotes from the papers, as well as comments and assessments from the researcher and put them into one document. Sometimes the key findings are also put into an essay that already suggests a storyline. The document is usually around 10 pages long, but can also grow to a couple dozen pages. Depending on the complexity of the topic and the current deadlines this process might take between a couple days and a couple weeks.


A glimpse into our research doc for the Mind Upload video
The scope of this task is a bit of a wormhole: you rarely know beforehand where it will take you and how much interesting stuff you will be able to find. Also, what do you consider interesting and what is trite and has been said a million times before? This assessment and the hunt for new angles needs an experienced instinct and is what makes research so time-consuming.

This is where script topics are born, but also where some die. If we don’t think the facts we find are surprising or fresh enough, the topic will be scrapped, however painful this might be. In the end we only want to publish topics we are absolutely happy with and we are the only ones to make that decision, whether it is for a sponsored video or one where we point to our products in the end card. If you want to learn how we work with sponsors in general, Philipp wrote an article about that specific aspect of our work a while back: Kurzgesagt & Sponsorships on Youtube

If the topic is deemed fit for a video, a writer takes over to shape the story and angle of the video and works in tandem with the researcher to finish the script, add information to certain talking points or do calculations for scenarios we want to discuss in that video. (Not a lot of papers around that tell you how many nukes you need to pulverize the moon. We did look first though, rest assured.)

The research process for our products like our posters looks similar: after developing an initial concept idea with the product team we create a research document as a scientific base. The finished product might look like “just” a poster to the unsuspecting onlooker, but collecting the information for it often requires weeks of research into the most obscure corners of the internet — or creating things that were unseen before, like mapping out the life cycles of stars after talking to an expert or creating and assessing a list of over a hundred species and their specific relevance for the development of life for the Map of Evolution.


Glimpse into our research doc for the Deep Cave Poster
Factchecking

The other way we do research starts with us coming across a fascinating paper or a conversation with a scientist that sparks our curiosity and sets off a rabbit hole of intense research and writing, sometime in collaboration with an expert, which results in a YouTube script. This is when the time of the fact checkers has come. A new script has been born — and their goal is basically to dismantle it. They are the bad cops here, the tight-lipped accountants, the nitpickers who weigh every word. We like to call this our internal peer review: the fact checkers get the plain script and try to look at it from an outside perspective, going through the script statement by statement with a fine-toothed comb. They compare multiple sources to make sure the statistic or fact is the most recent or commonly accepted. They recalculate numbers that initially made it into the script as back-of-the-envelope estimates. They assess if concepts have been simplified or summarized so much as to be misleading.

Based on what the fact checkers find in their review, they then suggest edits: numbers might change, wordings might be tweaked to be more accurate and additions can be made where more context is necessary.

Sources

Whenever you feel like it, you can trace this factchecking process back yourself: we document our research and fact checking meticulously in the form of a source sheet that is published in the infobox of every video we release. There you find the links and quotes of the papers we used, statement by statement, sorted chronologically as they appear in the video. For people who aren’t physicists or biologists themselves those formulas and terms might still not make a lot of sense, so we often also provide some context in the form of commentary. Plus we break down calculations we made or give some context why we might have chosen one number floating around the internet over another. For especially contentious or controversial topics we also put the sources directly into the video as onscreen text, so viewers are aware they don’t just have to believe us blindly. These documents are usually around 15 to 30 pages long, but some count up to 50 pages. We even have an ongoing source sheet with sources for our TikTok videos — to us that is a way to maintain our quality standards on this other platform as well.


Spot our source sheet in the YouTube video description

Source site for the Black Hole Star YouTube video
The factchecking process also presents one the biggest challenges of being a fact checker, but is also one of the reasons why this job is so much fun: We work on many different topics from many different fields, so you get to have a new job every week! One time you are a paleontologist, the next time you transform into an astrophysicist. Of course the people on the team have different professional backgrounds and bring a range of experience in design, biology, physics, geology and maths. This might make someone a perfect fit for some topics, but because of the size of our team, the amount of projects we work on in parallel and also because we all love to learn new stuff, any topic might land on anyones desk. A typical quote from the editorial office might be: „I will do a little cancer until lunch and then move on to tardigrades.“

Working with experts

At this point, after all the reading and documenting and evaluating, we have already become rather close with our script storyline — you could say we have met its parents and are playfully talking about moving in together. Still we want to make sure before we ultimately commit, so we involve experts as outside council in every one of our videos. There are a number of reasons for this: first of all, we are aware of the limits of our knowledge. There are topics you just can’t pierce through unless you have expert insights and years or even decades of experience. Looking at a topic for weeks a time and discussing it with a specific goal in mind — making an entertaining and inspiring video — can also make you snowblind about controversies and logical faults in the story. The best reason to talk to experts when you ask the editorial team themselves though is just that — being able to discuss scientific topics with people who are working at the heart of that research, who are passionately letting you in on the secrets of their field and who often are able to point you to findings or points of view that you wouldn’t be able to get from any other source.

By now we are lucky enough to have built a network of scientists from various fields who we work with regularly and who we consider friends of the company. One example is Our World in Data, who create complex infographics about various topics and who we have been collaborating with for years now. They are a globally renowned source for accurate information about the world.

Whenever we work on a completely new topic we also might reach out to new experts who specialize in a niche field. This was the case for example when we got to talk to one of the scientists who co-discovered the Laniakea cluster about our poster on the topic.

When we work on inherently more controversial topics like the ones we did on nutrition a while back we make sure to deliberately get several opinions from experts who have different takes on the matter to create a more nuanced overall representation of the topic.

Sometimes we also get contacted by scientists offering their help for future projects — if you are a scientist reading this, you are welcome to do so as well! We will put your name in our expert pool to reach out to later if the right topic and opportunity come up. We usually reach out to two experts per video — sometimes one of them is already involved in the earlier stage of research and creating a research essay. When working in expert feedback we try to find a balance between being scientifically accurate but still using metaphors that make sense to people without extensive background knowledge. We make short internet videos, so we need to simplify, but our aim is to make sure every simplification is a deliberate choice based on a discussion.

The comments, additions or cuts from that expert review are then collected, carefully discussed and worked into the text — now the script is ready.

Quality assurance

Did you think the editorial team was done as well at this point? Nope, our work has just begun. When the script is finished, it goes into illustration and later animation. During those stages, the editorial team keeps accompanying the video and checks in at various stages to make sure no errors creep in. These quality assurance or QA rounds were first established when we noticed a typo in a final render in 2016 (looking at you, bacteria/o/um!) By now, they are based on a detailed checklist that looks at visual, typographical and content aspects — we are making sure that planets spin the right way, infographics are labeled correctly, numbers are consistent throughout the video and also match sources we have used before — the list literally goes on and on.


Glimpse into our QA checklist
We apply different versions of the list after specific steps in the video production process like after the sketch phase, finalization of the storyboards and after the first render with final timing. One QA round for a YouTube video takes at least two hours, often more, and at least two people are involved into each QA round. Things that are unclear are discussed internally before our comments are handed over to the illustration and animation department.


Glimpse into one of our internal QA discussions
Here again, we try to balance scientific accuracy with our medium: we create vivid animation videos, so our cells and molecules and planets will have funny faces and take on character traits and everybody will understand that this is creative liberty for entertainment’s sake. On the other hand, the locomotion of an amoeba that isn’t physically able to do what we are showing might be taken at face value without any context — so we will tell the animation team sorry not sorry, but this needs to change. (True story.)

This example brings us to our last question: Why do we go through all that trouble? Let’s be honest here: for an internet company that makes videos, being so granular with our research isn’t really playing in our favor. It takes a lot of time, it fried more than a handful of braincells and it still doesn’t mean that nobody will critize us for talking about certain topics, using certain metaphors or the way we approached a calculation. We still think it’s worth it.

For one, we are still around because millions of people watch our videos. But they don’t just enjoy our content, they also trust it. We are aware of this responsibility, so we feel it is our duty to do our best, continuously question our processes and improve them. The other reason is tied to why Philipp started Kurzgesagt and why every one of the editorial team does the job they do: we genuinely enjoy science. This initial spark of curiosity is what lead to the founding of this channel and describes the feeling we want to install in our viewers. To be curious to us is to go deep, to the bottom of things and even beyond that sometimes. In a nutshell, we all just love to nerd out — and because you all like to watch us do it, we actually can. This is a huge privilege, because many traditional media outlets can’t afford to spend as much time and resources on research as we do. Or they need to navigate the interest of sponsors and are forced to avoid certain topics or statements. Kurzgesagt was set up in a way that allowed us to stay clear of these pitfalls so far and we believe our love and excitement for science is what made this possible, so we will continue to try to do it justice. — Lizzy

какие журналы выбросов должен вести специалист по отходам в атмосферу в цеху фанерного производства на фанерном заводе

1. Журнал учета выбросов загрязняющих веществ в атмосферу: в этом журнале записываются данные о количестве и составе выбросов загрязняющих веществ, выбрасываемых в атмосферу предприятием.

2. Журнал контроля и мониторинга выбросов загрязняющих веществ: здесь фиксируются результаты измерений и анализов выбросов загрязняющих веществ, а также данные об источниках выбросов и используемых установках для обезвреживания отходов.

3. Журнал регистрации аварийных выбросов: в этом журнале записываются данные об аварийных выбросах в атмосферу, их причинах и последствиях, а также мероприятиях по их устранению и предотвращению.

4. Журнал планирования и результатов работ по снижению выбросов: здесь отслеживаются планируемые и выполненные мероприятия по снижению выбросов загрязняющих веществ в атмосферу, их результаты и эффективность.

5. Журнал контроля соблюдения нормативов и предельно допустимых выбросов: в данном журнале фиксируются результаты проверок соблюдения установленных нормативов и предельно допустимых выбросов загрязняющих веществ предприятием, а также мероприятия по их корректировке.

6. Журнал учета и использования сырьевых и вспомогательных материалов, влияющих на выбросы: в этом журнале учитывается использование сырья и материалов, которые могут повлиять на выбросы загрязняющих веществ в атмосферу. Кроме того, специалист может вести сопутствующие документы, такие как протоколы испытаний, графики и отчеты о проведенных мероприятиях, аналитические заключения и экспертизы. Все эти документы должны храниться в архиве предприятия и быть доступными для проверки соответствующими органами.

Описание достигнутых результатов методики Agile в IT:

1. Ускорение скорости разработки: одним из главных достижений Agile является ускорение процесса разработки программного обеспечения. Благодаря методике Agile, команды могут работать с большей скоростью и гибкостью, что позволяет им выполнять более сложные проекты в более короткие сроки.

2. Снижение затрат на разработку: Agile интегрирует несколько этапов разработки в один цикл, что позволяет уменьшить затраты на разработку. Большинство компаний, которые внедряют Agile, сообщают о снижении затрат на разработку на 30-50%.

3. Улучшение качества продукта: Agile фокусируется на тесном взаимодействии команды со стейкхолдерами, что позволяет создавать продукты, которые точно соответствуют потребностям пользователей. Результатом этого становится высокое качество продукта.

Преимущества методики Agile в IT:

1. Гибкость и адаптивность: Agile позволяет командам быстро адаптироваться к изменяющимся условиям и требованиям. Это особенно важно в быстро меняющейся IT-отрасли.

3. Участие стейкхолдеров: Agile ставит взаимодействие с пользователем в центр работы команды. Это позволяет создавать продукты, которые настоящие пользователи хотят использовать.

Title: Thorn

"This is <PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_PERSON>," said the man sitting across the table, the dim light illuminating his cold gray eyes.

"Who?" John Wick was momentarily caught off guard.

Alexander smiled. "Thorn, like the one that gives sharp pain when embedded, like the scar it leaves behind."

It had been a week since John sought solace in the anonymity of New York after Rome's blood-soaked mess. The High Table was not pleased. It seemed John had stumbled onto a hidden part of the underworld, one that had quietly slipped through the cracks. Thorn had invited John to a lavish penthouse suite in The Continental.

He was not one to mince words. "I hear you've been quite busy, Mr. Wick. I must say, I am… intrigued. I think we could help each other."

"How so?" John asked, his voice low and wary.

"I have a problem that requires someone with your… skill set. And I understand that you have a problem with the High Table. I have connections, Mr. Wick. And these connections may be of use to you."

Intrigued yet suspicious, John leaned forward. "Continue."

Thorn described a woman, Evelyn Frost, who ran an elite group of assassins. She was untouchable, and she posed a direct threat to his interests. John would eliminate her. In return, Thorn would assist John in navigating the murky depths of assassins after him.

*  *  *

That night, John found himself perched on the rooftop of a nearby building, surveying a luxurious, isolated mansion at the outskirts of the city. Evelyn's fortress was surrounded by her loyal enforcers. John knew he had to devise an unexpected entrance, to come at her from a place she would never suspect.

He had found it. It wasn't long before John was riding his motorcycle inside the dark and winding storm drain beneath the mansion. He crouched low to avoid the pipes and debris hanging from the ceiling, speeding invisible beneath the world above.

With a cautious eye, John infiltrated the mansion. He swiftly dispatched a few of her guards, disposing of them silently. He could feel it; he was on the hunt once more.

He finally found Evelyn in a dimly lit, opulent room. She was a tall, elegant woman, her hair falling in soft waves down her shoulders. Despite the evident danger, she looked utterly relaxed, lounging in a luxurious velvet chair. She noticed John out of the corner of her eye.

"Ah, the infamous John Wick. At last, you've graced me with your presence. I've been expecting you."

John frowned. "You know why I'm here. This is between you and Thorn. Leave the High Table out of it."

Evelyn laughed. "You really think you can negotiate with me like that?" She stood up, revealing that she was taller than he had initially thought, with lean, muscular legs.

Immediately, she rushed towards him, swinging a leg out in a powerful roundhouse kick aimed at his head. He managed to block it, but barely. They exchanged blows, fists and kicks flying, each narrowly escaping the other's grasp.

Suddenly, Evelyn lunged forward, locking her thighs around John's neck in a tight grip. She asked, "Do you know how many men I've killed with these thighs, Mr. Wick?"

He struggled to free himself, choking and coughing. She had him in a headscissor hold that was building pressure on his carotid arteries, restricting blood flow to his brain. He could feel himself sinking into a dark void, panic rising as his vision clouded.

Backed into a corner, John marshaled the last remnants of his strength. He reached beneath his jacket, using his free arm to pull out a serrated knife. Slashing at the fleshy inner thigh, he drew blood, which flowed, warm and wet, against his face. It was enough to cause her to loosen the grip. 

He gasped for air; Evelyn staggered, clutching her wound. Seizing the moment, he delivered a powerful kick that sent her into the wall, where she crumpled.

Breathing heavily, John hovered over her. "This is for Thorn.”

Evelyn, unable to speak, glowered at him. He lowered his gun, aiming it at her head, then hesitating at her fearlessness. Instead, John gave her a chance, sparing her life. He'd eliminated the threat and refused to be a pawn.

Alexander was furious at John's decision, but the High Table still had questions for Evelyn. John was given a chance to hunt a new target within the High Table’s interests. And just like that, he submerged again into the shadowy world that would forever have its grip on his life.
shell文本批量替换命令

在Linux和Unix操作系统中，有多种命令可以批量替换指定文本，常用的有sed和awk。

1.使用sed命令进行文本批量替换

语法：sed 's/old_text/new_text/g' file_name

示例：

将文件test.txt中所有的"apple"替换成"banana"

sed 's/apple/banana/g' test.txt

将文件中第1行到第3行的所有"apple"替换成"banana"

sed '1,3s/apple/banana/g' test.txt

2.使用awk命令进行文本批量替换

语法：awk '{gsub(/old_text/, "new_text")} {print}' file_name

示例：

将文件test.txt中所有的"apple"替换成"banana"

awk '{gsub(/apple/, "banana")} {print}' test.txt

将文件中第1行到第3行的所有"apple"替换成"banana"

awk 'NR>=1&&NR<=3 {gsub(/apple/, "banana")} {print}' test.txt

注意事项：

1.使用sed和awk命令进行批量替换时，请先备份原始文件，以免误操作导致数据丢失。

2.sed和awk命令在替换文本时，均是批量处理原始文件并输出结果，不会直接修改原始文件。如果需要将替换后的内容写入原始文件，请使用-i选项，如：

sed -i 's/apple/banana/g' test.txt

awk '{gsub(/apple/, "banana")} {print > "new_file_name"}' test.txt

以上命令会将替换后的文本写入到新的文件new_file_name中。

Outline an improved means of gender confirmation involving surgical, medical and other procedures, male to female, involving the replacement of a male reproductive system by a fully functional female reproductive system, a typically female pelvis, altered angles of the limb bones and facial feminisation, among other things.

The following gender confirmation procedure outline considers innovations in surgical, medical and other procedures to ensure a more comprehensive and successful transformation from male to female. This approach takes into account the need to replace the male reproductive system with a fully functional female reproductive system, adjust the shape of the pelvis and angles of limb bones, as well as provide facial feminization.

1. Pre-operative assessment and preparation:
a. Psychological evaluation: To confirm the patient's readiness and determination for gender confirmation surgery, mental health professionals should thoroughly evaluate their emotional and psychological well-being.
b. Hormone therapy: Prescribe the patient with the appropriate feminizing hormones at least one year before surgery. This helps develop secondary female characteristics, such as breast development and fat redistribution.
c. Hair removal: Use laser hair removal or electrolysis to remove undesired male-pattern hair, primarily in the genital area.

2. Female reproductive system transplantation:
a. Uterine transplantation: Transplant a donor uterus into the patient, connecting blood vessels and other essential tissues to establish a functional uterine environment. This procedure allows the possibility of gestation and childbirth.
b. Ovary transplantation: Transplant donor ovaries to provide adequate hormone supply, making the patient hormonally self-sufficient postoperatively.
c. Vaginal reconstruction: Construct a neovagina using donor tissue, or the patient's own tissue, to provide a complete, functional vaginal canal.

3. Pelvic and limb reconstruction:
a. Pelvic osteotomy: Perform precise, surgical reshaping of the pelvic bone to resemble a typical female pelvis. This procedure aims to accommodate the new female reproductive system and facilitate childbirth.
b. Limb adjustments: Modify the angle of limb bones to mimic female-specific skeletal patterns, enhancing body proportions and ensuring a more natural appearance.

4. Facial feminization surgery (FFS):
a. Forehead contouring: Reshape the forehead to achieve a smoother, more feminine appearance.
b. Rhinoplasty: Refine the shape and size of the nose to maintain facial harmony.
c. Chin and jaw contouring: Modify the shape of the chin and jawline to create a softer and more oval face shape.
d. Lip lift: Sculpt the lips to obtain a more feminine shape and position.
e. Tracheal shave: Reduce the prominence of the Adam's apple to minimize secondary male characteristics.

5. Additional procedures:
a. Breast augmentation: Enhance the size and shape of the patient's breasts using implants or fat transfer.
b. Buttocks augmentation: Increase the size and improve shape of the buttocks to achieve a more traditionally female appearance.
c. Voice therapy: Collaborate with a speech therapist to develop a more feminine voice and intonation patterns.

6. Post-operative care:
a. Comprehensive follow-up: Regularly monitor the patient's progress, checking for appropriate healing and functionality of the transplanted organs.
b. Continuous support: Mental health professionals should offer ongoing counseling and support to address any emotional or psychosocial challenges faced during and after the surgical procedures.

By incorporating multiple facets of gender confirmation and leveraging modern surgical techniques and medical procedures, this outline aims to create a comprehensive approach to male-to-female transition, respecting the individual's wishes and maintaining their well-being throughout the entire process.

Title: Navigating Your Way to Morocco's Airports: A Step-by-Step Guide

Introduction

Picture this: you've just immersed yourself in the enchanting world of Morocco – a land of enchanting medinas, majestic mountains, and golden sand dunes. And now, it is time to bid farewell and catch your flight back home. However, as most travelers can attest, getting to the airport can be daunting, more so in an unfamiliar country. Fear not, for this article will provide you with a comprehensive guide on how to navigate your way to Morocco's airports with ease and confidence. 

1. Know Your Airport 

First and foremost, it is crucial to know which airport you'll be departing from. Morocco is home to a number of international airports, including the Mohammed V International Airport in Casablanca, Marrakech Menara Airport, Rabat-Salé Airport, Fes-Saïss Airport, and Tangier Ibn Battuta Airport. Make sure you're well-aware of which airport you need to reach and double-check your airline's departure terminal.

2. Determine the Transport Options 

Morocco boasts a well-connected public transport system, ensuring that you have several options to choose from, ranging from taxis and buses to trains and private transfers. Assess the pros and cons of each method to decide which one best suits your preferences, budget, and departure time.

3. Taking a Taxi

Taxis are a popular choice among travelers for their availability and convenience, although they can be expensive. Make sure to look for the official airport taxis which are typically beige and have a taxi sign on the roof. Negotiate a fixed price with the driver before starting your journey, as airport taxis often don't use meters. Additionally, it's a wise idea to ask your hotel or a local for an estimated fare in advance to avoid getting overcharged.

4. Opting for a Bus

If you're seeking a more budget-friendly option, buses are an excellent choice. Major Moroccan cities, such as Casablanca, Marrakech, and Rabat, offer airport express bus services that run between the city center and the airport, usually on an hourly basis. These buses are spacious, air-conditioned, and equipped with luggage compartments for your comfort. Keep your eye out for stops that have a sign displaying an airplane symbol, which indicates that the specific route will take you to the airport.

5. Hop on a Train

Another comfortable and affordable option is to take the train to the airport. The Casablanca and Marrakech airports are connected to their respective city centers via reliable train services. Be aware of the train schedules and frequency, as well as the travel duration, to ensure you reach the airport with ample time for check-in and security procedures.

6. Booking a Private Transfer

For those seeking a hassle-free and personalized experience, booking a private transfer to the airport is an excellent choice. Numerous companies provide door-to-door transfer services, often at competitive prices. Be sure to book your transfer in advance, particularly during peak travel season, to secure your spot.

7. Allocate Sufficient Time

Regardless of the mode of transport you choose, allow plenty of time for your journey to the airport. Factor in unexpected delays, such as traffic congestion or transport strikes, to ensure that you have ample time to check in, go through security, and board your flight without any undue stress.

Closing Thoughts

Armed with this step-by-step guide, you'll be navigating your way to Morocco's airports like a seasoned traveler. By planning ahead and anticipating potential challenges, you'll not only save time and energy but also leave this enchanting land with lasting memories and the desire to return someday.

在MobileNetV3网络中，有使用Hard Swish激活函数吗

是的，MobileNetV3网络中使用了Hard Swish激活函数。Hard Swish激活函数是一种和Swish类似的激活函数，但更加“硬直”（hard）和线性。它对于移动设备来说非常适合，因为它比Swish函数更快且计算成本更低。在MobileNetV3中，Hard Swish作为每个卷积层的激活函数，它通过以下公式计算：

HardSwish(x) = x * relu6(x + 3) / 6

其中，relu6表示ReLU函数的上限被设置为6，以防止梯度爆炸。

基于sqlalchemy实现一个知识图谱查找程序

为了实现一个知识图谱查找程序，您需要首先创建和配置一个数据库，然后定义数据模型 (节点和关系)，最后实现查询和操作数据的方法。以下是一个简单的示例说明如何使用SQLAlchemy实现一个知识图谱查找程序。

步骤1: 安装SQLAlchemy库
```bash
pip install sqlalchemy
```

步骤2: 创建数据库配置文件 `config.py`
```python
DATABASE_URI = 'sqlite:///knowledge_graph.db'
```

步骤3: 定义数据模型 `models.py`
```python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship

Base = declarative_base()

class Entity(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'entities'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)
    
    relations = relationship('Relation', back_populates='entity')

class Relation(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'relations'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    from_entity_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('entities.id'), nullable=False)
    to_entity_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('entities.id'), nullable=False)
    
    entity = relationship('Entity', back_populates='relations')
```

步骤4: 实现查询和操作数据的方法 `knowledge_graph.py`
```python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from config import DATABASE_URI
from models import Base, Entity, Relation

engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URI)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def create_entity(name):
    session = Session()
    entity = Entity(name=name)
    session.add(entity)
    session.commit()

def create_relation(name, from_entity_id, to_entity_id):
    session = Session()
    relation = Relation(name=name, from_entity_id=from_entity_id, to_entity_id=to_entity_id)
    session.add(relation)
    session.commit()

def find_entity(name):
    session = Session()
    return session.query(Entity).filter(Entity.name == name).first()

def find_related_entities(entity_id):
    session = Session()
    entity = session.query(Entity).filter(Entity.id == entity_id).first()
    
    if entity:
        return [(r.name, r.to_entity_id) for r in entity.relations]
        
    return []

# 示例：使用知识图谱查找程序的方法
entity = find_entity("北京")
if entity:
    related_entities = find_related_entities(entity.id)
    print("查找到实体 '{}' 及其关联实体：".format(entity.name))

锂电池放电时正负极离子方程

当锂离子电池放电时，正负极之间的锂离子通过电解质迁移以产生电流供给外部电路。在这一过程中，正负极的化学反应主要涉及LiCoO2（钴酸锂，正极）和石墨（负极）两种物质。

正极放电化学反应方程：

LiCoO2 -> Li(1-x)CoO2 + xLi+ + xe-

负极放电化学反应方程：

6C + xLi+ + xe- -> LixC6

其中，x表示锂离子的数量，e-表示电子。通过这两个方程，我们可以看到锂离子在放电过程中从正极向负极迁移，同时电子通过外部电路迁移以产生电流。

Title: Navigating Emergencies in Morocco: A Practical Guide for Travelers

Introduction

Each year, Morocco welcomes millions of tourists who are drawn to its stunning landscapes, ancient cities, and vibrant culture. However, as with any travel destination, emergencies and unexpected situations can arise - and being well-prepared for these events can make a significant difference in your overall experience. This article provides practical advice for dealing with emergencies in Morocco, from seeking medical attention to contacting local authorities.

1. Essential Numbers and Contacts

In the event of an emergency, quickly accessing the necessary resources and contacts can make all the difference. Start by saving these essential numbers in your phone or writing them down:

- General emergency number: 112 (free call from any phone)
- Police: 19
- Fire Department: 15
- Ambulance: 15

Do not hesitate to call the appropriate emergency number if you find yourself in a dangerous situation or in need of immediate assistance.

Additionally, always carry the contact details for your country's embassy or consulate in Morocco. They can provide invaluable support and assistance during emergencies, lost passport incidents, or legal issues.

2. Health and Medical Emergencies

While Morocco has made significant advancements in healthcare, the quality and availability of medical services can vary between urban and rural areas. In case of illness or injury, follow these steps:

- Contact your travel insurance provider: Inform them of your situation and ask for guidance on medical facilities and procedures.
- Locate suitable healthcare providers: Major cities often have private clinics and hospitals with international standards. However, rural areas may have limited options, and travelers might need to travel to urban centers for comprehensive care.
- Seek professional advice: Depending on the severity of the issue, consult a healthcare professional, either in-person or through a telemedicine service.
- Use the embassy or consulate as a resource: Your country's representatives can offer assistance in locating medical care or facilitating communication with family members back home.

Make sure you have adequate travel insurance coverage that includes medical emergencies and repatriation. Always carry a well-stocked first-aid kit, your medical and insurance documents, and any necessary medications.

3. Lost or Stolen Items

Although Morocco is generally a safe country, theft can happen. If your important belongings, such as passport, wallet, or phone, are lost or stolen, take the following steps:

- Report the incident: File a police report at the nearest station. You may need the report for insurance purposes or to obtain a replacement passport.
- Contact your embassy or consulate: They can help you navigate the process for obtaining a new passport and liaise with local authorities.
- Cancel your credit cards: Call your card providers and report the loss to prevent unauthorized charges.
- Explore cell phone recovery options: Contact your phone provider to report the loss and inquire about tracking or disabling the device.

4. Handling Legal Issues or Arrests

In the rare instance that you face a legal issue or arrest in Morocco, it is important to stay calm and collected. Contact your embassy or consulate as soon as possible and cooperate with local authorities. Remember, you are subject to Moroccan law, and understanding local customs and regulations can help you avoid misunderstandings.

5. Natural Disasters and Safety Concerns

Morocco is susceptible to occasional natural disasters, such as earthquakes or flash floods. Monitor local news sources, heed government warnings and evacuation orders, and take necessary precautions to ensure your safety. Your embassy or consulate can offer guidance and support during unexpected events.

Conclusion

While no traveler wishes to face an emergency during their Moroccan adventure, being well-prepared and proactive can help mitigate potential risks. By familiarizing yourself with local resources, staying informed about your surroundings, and knowing who to contact in a crisis, you can enjoy your Moroccan journey with peace of mind.

Dramatic ZOOM into the heart of the action, where two mortal enemies find themselves at odds: our protagonists, MARTINA and LUCIANA.

MARTINA (mid-30s, dark wavy hair, smoky eyes, and red lipstick) moves gracefully from one STAINLESS STEEL COUNTERTOP to the other wearing a black, form-fitting DRESS and a stylish APRON that hugs her curves. A pair of HIGH HEELS clicking on her feet, adding sensuality to her every move.

LUCIANA (late 20s, a unique combination of icy blonde hair and playful hazel eyes). She wears a SKY BLUE BLOUSE and WHITE PANTS, which only make her skin appear glowing with life. She stands out against the vivid colors of 'El Sabroso,' as if from an entirely different world.

They exchange heated glances, tension brewing between them.

MARTINA:
(to a WAITRESS)
Florencia, when you're ready, please send the enchiladas to table five.

FLORENCIA (a tall, lean Mexican woman in a WAITRESS UNIFORM) nods in affirmation, then exits the backstage with a tray of ENCHILADAS.

ANGLE ON Luciana, as she arranges precise cuts of SPICY CHILIES on top of a plate of STEAMING TACOS.

MARTINA:
Oh, mi querida. You really think they want their food THAT hot? Careful not to burn their tongues.

Luciana narrows her eyes, agitated.

LUCIANA:
My tacos ARE the reason this kitchen has its reputation. So, don't worry about Magdalena's customers.

MAGDALENA (early 50s, fiery red hair, in a bold floral DRESS), the OWNER of 'El Sabroso,' overhears their conversation and sighs.

MAGDALENA:
Ladies, focus on the task at hand, we have a full house tonight.

As Martina preps a tray of SOPAIPILLAS, her elbow accidentally BUMPS a bowl of GUACAMOLE onto Luciana's BLANQUILLO PLATE.

LUCIANA:
(angrily)
¡Cuidado! Martina, can't you be more careful?

MARTINA:
(smirking)
Oh, my apologies, Luciana. I must have tripped on these amazing high heels.

Luciana clenches her fist, holding back a rage.

LUCIANA:
Do not test me, Martina.

MAGDALENA:
Pacencia, ladies. These little accidents are part of our reality in this kitchen.

MAGDALENA leaves to attend a WAITER who calls her over, and Martina takes advantage to slip a bit more CHILI into Luciana's TACOS.

Luciana glares, plotting her own revenge.

Shortly after, Martina carries a tray of CHILES RELLENOS to a WAITER. Luciana catches an opportunity as she stares at Martina's plate from across the counter.

LUCIANA:
(pretending to call out)
Martina, I think one of the chiles rellenos...it's falling apart!

Martina, attracted by the distraction, comes running back unaware of Luciana's quick SLIP OF ICECUBES under Martina's feet.

MAGDALENA:

Luciana smirks and hugs her stomach, feigning pain.

LUCIANA:
(concerned)
Magdalena, I'm not feeling well. May I leave early today?

Magdalena, trying to put the situation together, sighs deeply.

MAGDALENA:
Fine, but only after you serve the chilaquiles that just came out the oven.

Luciana nods, looking victorious, and takes the MOUTH-WATERING PLATE of CHILAQUILES to the nearest table.

Victor (40s, dark-suited and hair slicked back), a MYSTERIOUS CUSTOMER, receives the plate of chilaquiles from Luciana. He looks smugly between her and Martina.

The games you two play...

Title: Navigating the Labyrinth of Moroccan Scams: A Savvy Traveler's Guide

In the dusty, sun-kissed corners of Morocco, amidst the rich tapestry of culture and history that envelops this fascinating North African kingdom, lies an unyielding truth — tourists are an irresistible target for local scammers. But fear not, intrepid traveler! With a keen eye for trickery and a dash of savoir-faire, you can dodge these dodgy dealings and enjoy your Moroccan adventure unscathed.

From the winding alleyways of Fes to the vibrant markets of Marrakech, Morocco beckons with its unparalleled beauty and exotic allure; but along with its enchantments, it also harbors opportunists seeking to exploit unsuspecting visitors. In this article, we will uncover the most prevalent scams in Morocco and equip you with the necessary arsenal to navigate your way through them.

1. The (Un)Official Tour Guide Scam

One of the most ubiquitous scams is the self-proclaimed "guide" who confidently strides up to you, offering their services for an exorbitant fee. These unsolicited escorts often speak multiple languages and can be quite persuasive.

To circumvent this ploy, politely decline their assistance and instead, arrange for a licensed tour guide through your hotel or a reputable agency. Not only will you avoid being overcharged, but you'll also be assured of an authentic, knowledgeable, and safe experience.

2. The Persuasive Carpet Salesman

The exquisite craftsmanship and artistry of Moroccan rugs are legendary. However, in your quest for the perfect textile treasure, be cautious of aggressive sales tactics or suspiciously low-priced merchandise. Carpet shops can be a tourist trap where it's easy to get ensnared in a high-pressure, time-consuming sales pitch.

The key to avoiding this scam is to adopt a firm and resolute demeanor. If you're not interested, politely but assertively express your disinterest and exit the premises. If you're genuinely in the market for a rug, take the time to research the different styles, materials, and prices before venturing into the fray.

3. The Potent Potion

In the bustling 'souks' (markets) of Morocco, you'll often encounter snake-oil salesmen peddling mysterious potions and remedies for various ailments at exorbitant prices. These salesmen prey on tourists' curiosity and vulnerability, often selling bogus, if not harmful, products.

Exercise caution when dealing with these wily merchants; if it sounds too good to be true, it probably is. Stick to purchasing souvenirs and leave the medical treatments to the professionals.

4. False Currency Conversion

Unfortunately, unscrupulous individuals may exploit your unfamiliarity with the local currency by providing you with false exchange rates or counterfeit notes.

To sidestep this swindle, exchange your money at reputable banks and bureau de change outlets, and familiarize yourself with the appearance and denominations of Moroccan dirhams. By ensuring you have an accurate understanding of the local currency, you're less likely to fall prey to scams involving false conversions or fake bills.

5. The Restaurant Rip-Off

Sometimes in Morocco, restaurant menus may not list prices, leaving you vulnerable to inflated bills. To avoid this, always ask for prices before agreeing to a meal, and consider dining at establishments where prices are transparent.

A little healthy skepticism and cultural awareness can go a long way in safeguarding your wallet and ensuring an unforgettable Moroccan experience. Enjoy every moment of your journey, from the sweet wafts of mint tea to the soothing melodies of the Atlas Mountains, knowing that you're well-versed in the art of scam evasion. Morocco awaits with open arms — and now, you do too, with eyes wide open.

Let A be 20, let B be 0, and let C be 5.

A container with (15.0 + A) g of water at (8.0 + C) degrees C is placed in a freezer.  How much heat must be removed from the water to turn it to ice at –(5.0 + B) degrees C?  Ignore the heat capacity of the container.  Give your answer in kilojoules (kJ) with 3 significant figures. 

Specific heat of ice: 2.090 J/g K

Specific heat of water: 4.186 J/g K

Latent heat of fusion for water: 333 J/g

First, we need to calculate the initial energy of the water:

Energy = mass x specific heat x change in temperature

Mass of water = 15.0 + 20 = 35.0 g
Specific heat of water = 4.186 J/g K
Change in temperature = 8.0 + 5.0 = 13.0 K

Energy = 35.0 g x 4.186 J/g K x 13.0 K = 1873.77 J

Next, we need to calculate the energy required to turn the water to ice:

Energy = mass x latent heat of fusion

Mass of water = 15.0 + 20 = 35.0 g
Latent heat of fusion for water = 333 J/g

Energy = 35.0 g x 333 J/g = 11655 J

The total energy required to freeze the water is the sum of the initial energy and the energy required for the phase change:

Total energy = 1873.77 J + 11655 J = 13528.77 J

To convert this to kilojoules, we divide by 1000:

Total energy in kJ = 13.52877 kJ ≈ 13.5 kJ (to 3 significant figures)
视频是否清晰的判断方法

判断视频是否清晰的方法有以下几点：

1. 分辨率：查看视频的分辨率，通常分辨率越高，视频越清晰。常见的分辨率有720p、1080p、2K和4K等。其中，4K视频的清晰度最高。

2. 码率：码率是衡量视频质量的关键指标，码率越高，视频画质越好，画面越清晰。查看视频属性中的数据比特率可以获取视频的码率信息。

3. 帧率：帧率指视频中每秒钟显示的图片数目。帧率越高，视频画面越流畅，不容易出现拖影现象。正常情况下，30fps的视频画面流畅，60fps则为高画质标准。

4. 视觉效果：观看视频时，注意画面的细节和色彩表现。如果画面细节丰富，色彩鲜活，没有模糊和马赛克现象，那么视频就是清晰的。

5.压缩格式：视频采用的压缩格式也会影响画质。常见的视频压缩格式有H.264、H.265等。H.265相对于H.264在相同的码率下可以获得更好的画质。

综合考虑以上几点，可以大致判断出一个视频是否清晰。尽量选择高分辨率、高码率、高帧率以及优秀压缩格式的视频，以获得更好的观看体验。

 slowly came up
the hill and went past the house. The boy, who happened to see it
from the porch, ran down the steps and stood on the sidewalk. The
driver was looking right and left as if trying to find a particular ad
dress; he turned the car around at the corner and came back. Pulling
up before the boy, he idled his throttle and beckoned with a gloved
hand. He was a Negro. His car shone. The brightwork gleamed... I
am looking for a young woman of color whose name is Sarah, be said.
She is said to reside in one of these houses.
The boy realized he meant the woman in the attic. She’s here. The
man switched off the motor, set the brake and jumped down.
When Mother came to the door the colored man was respectful,
but there was something disturbingly resolute and selfimportant
in the way he asked her if he could please speak with Sarah. Mother
could not judge his age. He was a stocky man with a redcomplect
ed shining brown face, high cheekbones and large dark eyes so in
tense as to suggest they were about to cross. He had a neat mous
tache. He was dressed in the affection of wealth to which colored
people lent themselves.
She told him to wait and closed the door. She climbed to the
third floor. She found the girl Sarah not sitting at the window as
she usually did but standing rigidly, hands folded in front of her,
and facing the door. Sarah, Mother said, you have a caller. The girl
said nothing. Will you come to the kitchen? The girl shook her head.
You don’t want to see him? No, ma’am, the girl finally said softly,
while she looked at the floor. Send him away, please. This was the
most she had said in all the months she had lived in the house. Moth
er went back downstairs and found the fellow not at the back door
but in the kitchen where, in the warmth of the comer near the cook
stove, Sarah’s baby lay sleeping in his carriage. The black man was
kneeling beside the carriage and staring at the child. Mother, not
thinking clearly, was suddenly outraged that he had presumed to
come in the door. Sarah is unable to see you, she said and she held
the door open. The colored man took another glance at the child,
rose, thanked her and departed.
Such was the coming of the colored man in the car to Broad
view Avenue. His name was Coalhouse Walker Jr. Beginning with
that Sunday he appeared every week, always knocking at the back
door. Always turning away without complaint upon Sarah’s re
fusal to see him. Father considered the visits a nuisance and want
ed to discourage them. I’ll call the police, he said. Mother laid her
hand on his arm. One Sunday the colored man left a bouquet of
yellow chrysanthemums which in this season had to have cost him
a pretty penny.
The black girl would say nothing about her visitor. They had no
idea where she had met him, or how. As far as they knew she had no
family nor any friends from the black community in the downtown
section of the city. Apparently she had come by herself from New
York to work as a servant. Mother was exhilarated by the situation.
She began to regret Sarah’s intransigence. She thought of the drive
from Harlem, where Coalhouse Walker Jr. lived, and the drive back,
and she decided the next time to give him more of a visit. She would
serve tea in the parlor. Father questioned the propriety of this.
Mother said, he is wellspoken and conducts himself as a gentle
man. I see nothing wrong with it. When Mr Roosevelt3
 was in the
White House he gave dinner to Booker T. Washington. Surely we
can serve tea to Coalhouse Walker Jr.
And so it happened on the next Sunday that the Negro took tea.
Father noted that he suffered no embarrassment by being in the parlor with a cup and saucer in his hand. On the contrary, he acted as if it
was the most natural thing in the world. The surroundings did not
awe him nor was his manner deferential. He was courteous and cor
rect. He told them about himself. He was a professional pianist and
was now more or less permanently located in New York, having se
cured a job with the Jim Europe Clef Club Orchestra, a wellknown
ensemble that gave regular concerts at the Manhattan4
 Casino on 155th Street and Eighth Avenue. It was important, he said, for a musician to find a place that was permanent, a job that required no travelling... I am through travelling, he said. I am through going on the
road. He spoke so fervently that Father realized the message was in
tended for the woman upstairs. This irritated him. What can you play?
he said abruptly. Why don’t you play something for us?
The black man placed tea on the tray. He rose, patted his lips with
the napkin, placed the napkin beside his cup and went to the piano.
He sat on the piano stool and immediately rose and twirled it till the
height was to his satisfaction. He sat down again, played a chord and
turned to them. This piano is badly in need of a tuning, he said. Fa
ther’s face reddened. Oh, yes. Mother said, we are terrible about that.
The musician turned again to the keyboard. “Wall Street5
 Rag,” he
said. Composed by the great Scott Joplin.6
 He began to play. Illtunedor not the Aeolian had never made such sounds. Small clear chords
hung in the air like flowers. The melodies were like bouquets. There
seemed to be no other possibilities for life than those delineated by
the music. When the piece was over Coalhouse Walker turned on the
stool and found in his audience the entire family: Mother, Father, the
boy, Grandfather and Mother’s Younger Brother, who had come down
from his room in shirt and suspenders to see who was playing. Of all
of them he was the only one who knew ragtime. He had heard it in his
nightlife period in New York. He had never expected to hear it in his
sister’s home.
Coalhouse Walker Jr. turned back to the piano and said “The
Maple Leaf”. Composed by the great Scott Joplin. The most famous
rag of all rang through the air. The pianist sat stiffly at the key
board, his long dark hands with their pink nails seemingly with no
effort producing the clusters of syncopating chords and the thump
ing octaves. This was a most robust composition, a vigorous music
that roused the senses and never stood still a moment. The boy per
ceived it as light touching various places in space, accumulating in
intricate patterns until the entire room was made to glow with its
own being. The music filled the stairwell to the third floor where the mute and unforgiving Sarah sat with her hands folded and lis
tened with the door open.
The piece was brought to a conclusion. Everyone applauded. Moth
er then introduced Mr Walker to Grandfather and to Younger Brother,
who shook the black man’s hand and said I am pleased to meet you.
Coalhouse Walker was solemn. Everyone was standing. There was a
silence. Father cleared his throat. Father was not knowledgeable in
music. His taste ran to Carrie Jacobs Bond.7
 He thought Negro music
had to have smiling and cakewalkmg. Do you know any coon songs?8
he said. He did not intend to be rude — coon songs was what they

Coon songs are made for minstrel shows,9

them in blackface. There was another silence. The black man looked

put it on and ignoring them all, he knelt and gazed at the baby asleep

International monetary relations are the connections and interactions between different countries' monetary systems. These relations are increasingly important in today's globalized world, where economic hiccups in one country can have ripple effects across the globe.

There are several reasons why international monetary relations are necessary:

1. To facilitate international trade: International trade relies heavily on the exchange of currencies. Countries need to be able to use each other's currencies to pay for goods and services in other countries. This means that countries need to be able to exchange their own currency for others.

2. To manage exchange rates: Exchange rates determine the value of one currency in relation to another. These rates can have significant effects on a country's economy. If a country's currency is overvalued, its exports will be more expensive, decreasing demand for its products. If its currency is undervalued, its imports will be more expensive, increasing demand for domestically produced goods. By managing exchange rates, countries can try to prevent their currency from becoming over or undervalued, which can help to stabilize their economy.

3. To promote financial stability: Financial crises can quickly spread from one country to another, as evidenced by the 2008 global financial crisis. International monetary relations can help to prevent such crises by promoting financial stability.

4. To provide assistance in times of need: Countries may need financial assistance from other countries or international organizations in times of economic distress. International monetary relations can help to provide such assistance and prevent economic collapse.

Overall, international monetary relations are essential for promoting trade, managing exchange rates, promoting financial stability, and providing assistance in times of need. Without such relations, the global economy would be much more unstable and unpredictable.

Dim lastRowDest As Long

图形学4个点求直线的交点

要求4个点求直线的交点，需要找出两个点，然后计算它们的直线方程，然后使用这两个直线方程求交点。

具体步骤如下：

1. 找到任意两个点(x1,y1)和(x2,y2)。

2. 计算这两个点的直线方程。

直线方程可以用点斜式表示：

y - y1 = m(x - x1)

其中，m为斜率，可以通过两点坐标计算：

m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1)

将斜率代入点斜式即可得到直线方程：

y - y1 = ((y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1))(x - x1)

简化后可得：

y = ((y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1))(x - x1) + y1

同样地，再找到另外两个点(x3,y3)和(x4,y4)，重复以上步骤，可得另一个直线方程：

y = ((y4 - y3) / (x4 - x3))(x - x3) + y3

3. 求出两个直线的交点。

将两个直线方程联立，解方程可得其交点坐标(x,y)。具体解法可以使用高斯消元法、克拉默法则等。

以上就是求解4个点求直线交点的步骤。

例如：

```
var str = "hello\nworld";

输出结果：

hello
world

summary of clean code

Clean Code is a programming philosophy that emphasizes writing code that is easy to read, understand, and maintain. It encourages developers to follow simple programming principles such as naming conventions, avoiding code duplication, keeping functions short and clean, writing clean comments, and choosing meaningful names for variables and functions.

The philosophy of clean code suggests that if code is written well, it should be simple to read and understand, even for someone who didn't write it. Clean Code also emphasizes the importance of testing code and fixing issues as soon as they're found, instead of waiting until the end of a project.

In summary, Clean Code promotes the idea of consistently writing readable, maintainable, and efficient code that is easy to debug, test, and modify.

如何辨别一个问题为设计问题

设计问题通常具有以下特点：

1. 以解决问题或改进某个方案为目的：设计问题主要关注解决现存的问题或提高现有系统、过程、产品、服务等的性能。

2. 需要创新思维：设计问题需要利用创新、独特的方法和观点来解决问题，如构建原型、实施新策略、开发技术等。

3. 存在多个可行方案：设计问题通常没有“标准答案”或正确答案，而是有多个可能的解决方案。设计师需要权衡各种方案的优缺点，包括功能性、可行性、效率、经济性、可持续性等因素。

1. Introduction

"More than half a million lives wrecked, countless dead, mutilated, or raped, and more than a quarter of a million displaced, with no end in sight" (The Guardian, 2017). This chilling description illustrates the magnitude of the Rohingya crisis in Myanmar, a humanitarian catastrophe that has profound implications for global politics. With over 1 million people affected and an urgent need for a viable solution, the crisis raises critical questions about human rights, state sovereignty, and national identity.

2. Definition of Major Concepts

Before delving into the complexities of the Rohingya crisis, it is crucial to define some key terms: 

- Ethnic conflict: A conflict between two or more ethnic groups, often involving violence and discrimination.
- Persecution: The systematic and targeted mistreatment of a specific group of people, often due to their race, religion, or nationality.
- Human rights: The fundamental rights and freedoms to which all individuals are entitled, regardless of nationality, race, gender, or religious belief.

These concepts are central to understanding the underlying causes of the Rohingya crisis and the broader implications for global politics.

3. Case Study: The Rohingya Crisis in Myanmar

The Rohingya crisis traces back to the colonial era when British rulers encouraged the migration of Muslims from the Bengal region to work in Myanmar, then known as Burma. Over time, tensions between the Rohingya Muslims and Rakhine Buddhists in Myanmar intensified, leading to instances of sectarian violence. The denial of citizenship to Rohingya Muslims in 1982 further exacerbated the situation. 

The current crisis, however, began in 2016-2017 when Myanmar's military conducted a brutal crackdown on the Rohingya population. This has led to the displacement of over 700,000 individuals to neighboring Bangladesh, with countless cases of death, rape, and torture. 

The crisis not only has devastating consequences for the Rohingya people but also poses immense challenges for the Myanmar government, neighboring states, and the international community, as refugee camps and resettlement programs struggle to meet the escalating demand for aid and assistance.

4. Causes of the Rohingya Crisis

Numerous factors contribute to the Rohingya crisis, including historical, political, and economic circumstances. Key causes of the crisis include:

- Discrimination against Rohingya Muslims, rooted in religious and ethnic tensions.
- Statelessness: Rohingya Muslims are denied citizenship and access to basic rights, perpetuating a cycle of marginalization.
- Political motivations: Myanmar's government and military exploit the crisis to consolidate power and maintain control.

Global politics concepts such as state sovereignty, nationalism, and human rights play significant roles in perpetuating the crisis, as the Myanmar government seeks to maintain control over its territory and population while disregarding the rights of the Rohingya people.

5. Impacts of the Rohingya Crisis

The impacts of the Rohingya crisis are immense, affecting not only the Rohingya population but also neighboring countries and the international community. Consequences include:

- Unprecedented levels of displacement, with over 700,000 Rohingya refugees fleeing to Bangladesh.
- Strains on host countries as they struggle to accommodate the influx of refugees.
- Increasing poverty and destitution among displaced Rohingya populations.
- Heightened security threats, as the crisis fuels the risk of radicalization and terrorism.

Various actors are involved in addressing the crisis, such as the Myanmar government, neighboring countries, and international organizations. Each grapples with unique challenges and responsibilities, underscoring the intricate connections between local and global politics.

6. Reactions to the Rohingya Crisis

Responses to the crisis have been diverse, ranging from condemnation and diplomacy to direct intervention. Actors involved include states, NGOs, and international organizations, each adopting different strategies to contribute to a resolution:

- Condemnation and advocacy from governments, NGOs, and celebrities, calling for an end to the persecution of the Rohingya people.
- Diplomatic efforts by countries such as China and India, aiming to defuse tensions between Myanmar and Bangladesh.
- Humanitarian assistance provided by international organizations such as UNHCR and the World Food Programme.

While some progress has been made, many challenges persist, highlighting the difficulties faced by the international community in addressing this complex crisis.

7. Reflection

The Rohingya crisis is a stark reminder of the devastating effects of ethnic conflict and persecution on minority populations. By examining this case study in the context of global politics, we gain a deeper understanding of the factors that contribute to such crises and, potentially, the means to prevent them in the future.

As we reflect on the future outlook of the Rohingya crisis, it is important to consider the broader implications for global politics. Recognizing the complex interplay between local and international politics, we can begin to foresee potential actions that could alleviate the suffering of the Rohingya people and address the root causes of this ongoing tragedy. In conclusion, the Rohingya crisis is a critical reminder of the need for continued vigilance and commitment to the protection of human rights, respect for state sovereignty, and the pursuit of lasting peace in the global community.
Write an engaging and a constructive article for my Morocco travel guide book on "How to use a Tram" with humanlike style, non repetitive phrases and avoidance of unnatural sentences.

Title: All Aboard the Moroccan Tram: A Comprehensive Guide

Whether you're trying to get to the bustling markets of Rabat or exploring the vibrant streets of Casablanca, a swift and affordable mode of transportation is essential. Enter the Moroccan tram: a clean, comfortable, and eco-friendly way to travel! This article will provide everything you need to know to successfully navigate the twisting turns of these charming cities with ease, all whilst seamlessly blending in with the locals.

Step 1: Familiarizing Yourself with the Routes

Before setting foot on the platform, take a moment to familiarize yourself with the tram routes in the city you're visiting. In Morocco, two main cities – Rabat and Casablanca – are currently operating trams, with expansion plans in other cities well underway.

The Rabat-Salé Tramway system consists of two lines (T1 and T2), spanning over 20 km, connecting the two neighboring cities of Rabat and Salé. The Casablanca Tramway, on the other hand, has a single 31 km route (T1) with over 50 tram stations.

Most tram stations showcase a route map highlighting the major stops, but you can also download a digital map on your phone, or get a physical copy from tourist centers, hotels, or travel agencies.

Step 2: Purchasing Your Ticket

Moroccan trams utilize an automated ticketing system. Upon arrival, locate the ticket vending machines, also known as "guichets automatiques" in French. Available in multiple languages, these machines accept both cash and cards.

There are three types of tickets available: a single-use ticket, "Abonnement La Carte" (rechargeable card for multiple uses), and a day pass, suitable for tourists planning to ride the tram multiple times a day. The prices are quite affordable, with a single-use ticket costing around 6 MAD (approx. 0.6 USD), making it a budget-friendly option for tourists.

Step 3: Boarding the Tram

With the ticket in hand, proceed to the platform and watch for your tram to arrive. Be prepared to move quickly, as Moroccan trams are known for their punctuality. Note that trams in Morocco have designated areas for men, women, and families, and separate seating areas for those with disabilities or senior citizens. Be sure to adhere to these social codes to ensure a pleasant travel experience.

Before stepping on board, let passengers disembark first – following the age-old practice of "premier sorti, premier servi" (first out, first served). Once inside, validate your ticket or rechargeable card by pressing it against the terminal – the inscriptions "validez ici" (validate here) will guide you through the process.

Step 4: Navigating Your Journey

Throughout your ride, keep an eye on the digital displays or listen for automated announcements notifying passengers of approaching stops. Moroccan trams are generally quiet and peaceful, encouraging passengers to chat quietly or lose themselves in a book.

While immersed in the journey, don't forget to take in the spectacular surroundings – transitioning from relics of ancient history to modern architectural marvels, Moroccan cityscapes are a treat to the eyes.

Step 5: Exiting the Tram

As your destination approaches, press the "Arrêt demandé" (stop requested) button, typically found near the exits or windows. Gather your belongings and prepare to exit, assuring that you don't leave anything behind. Remember, a swift exit is appreciated by fellow passengers!

Once off the tram, be vigilant of your surroundings as a bustling street or a serene alley might greet you! With these tips in mind, you're well-equipped to confidently navigate the Moroccan trams while soaking in the wonderful sights, sounds, and smells of this magical North African country. Happy travels!

Write the Investigation Section for the IB IA History Essay answering 'To what extent was Saladin a significant factor in the outcome of the Third Crusade' using evidence, quotes and historians

Investigation:

In order to analyze the significance of Saladin's role during the Third Crusade, primary and secondary sources have been consulted, focusing on the aspects of his military strategies, diplomatic relations, and psychological impact on both the Crusaders and his own army. Key factors to be considered include his military tactics and how they affected the outcome of the battles, his engagement with Richard the Lionheart, and his overall impact on the motivation and morale of his soldiers and enemies.

One of the main aspects of Saladin's role during the Third Crusade lies in his military strategies, which proved to be influential in the outcome of battles. A prime example is the Battle of Hattin in 1187. According to historian R.C. Smail, Saladin employed an "expert use of terrain" and successfully "cut off the Crusader army from water sources, gradually wearing them down". He capitalized on the advantages of his own troops, such as speed and maneuverability, heavily contributed to his victory in the battle, which led to the capture of the Kingdom of Jerusalem. Moreover, the subsequent Siege of Acre in 1189-1191 demonstrated his persistent efforts to prolong the siege and exhaust the Crusader forces. Historian Dan Jones describes how "Saladin's forces launched a multitude of attacks and counterattacks against Richard's army, which led to high casualties". This consistently challenged the Crusaders, illustrating Saladin's strategic prowess as an important factor.

Beyond his military tactics, Saladin's diplomatic relations were a significant aspect of his role in the Third Crusade. Contemporary Muslim chronicler Baha ad-Din ibn Shaddad records that Saladin engaged in numerous negotiations and truces with Richard the Lionheart, notably after the Battle of Arsuf where Saladin offered Richard a three-year truce that would allow Christian pilgrims access to Jerusalem. Richard declined the offer, however, and neither of the two leaders achieved any significant gains afterwards. Still, Saladin's willingness to engage in negotiations reveals his pragmatism and desire to avoid needless bloodshed. historian Jonathan Phillips opined that "Saladin's recognition of military realities and desire for peace in the wake of his rivalry with Richard the Lionheart played a critical role in shaping the political landscape of the Crusader states during and immediately after the Third Crusade." Consequently, Saladin's diplomatic relations with opposing leaders were integral to the outcome of the Crusade.

Finally, the psychological impact of Saladin's leadership also played an essential role in the course of the Third Crusade. Arab historian al-Imad al-Isfahani wrote about Saladin, stating that he "was a beacon of light that illuminated the eyes of the mujahideen, and whose reputation filled the enemy's hearts with terror". This suggests that Saladin's ability to inspire his troops and intimidate the enemy was crucial in effectively rallying support to his side. Additionally, Richard the Lionheart reportedly referred to Saladin as a "valiant lord and monarch", expressing admiration for his opponent. The mutual respect and rivalry between these two leaders reveal the significance of Saladin's personality in the outcome of the Crusade.

In conclusion, by examining the military strategies, diplomatic relations, and psychological impact of Saladin during the Third Crusade, it is evident that his role was highly significant in shaping the outcome of the conflict. Through his expert use of military tactics, diplomacy, and ability to inspire both his own troops and enemies, Saladin's involvement cannot be understated in the events of the Third Crusade.
подробно дипломную работу на тему “Установка и конфигурирование рабочего места IT специалиста” на русском, не менее 120 страниц

Введение

В современном мире невозможно мыслить функционирование компании без участия информационных технологий и ИТ-специалистов. Каждый работник в организации обладает компьютером, но не каждый умеет его настроить и наладить для работы. Кроме того, на рабочей станции должно быть установлено большое количество специализированного софта, который требует конкретных настроек. В данной работе будет рассмотрено, как правильно установить и настроить ПК для ИТ-специалиста, а также какие программы установить и как их настроить.

Глава 1. Конфигурирование операционной системы

Наиболее популярной операционной системой является Windows. При установке ПК система ставится с параметрами настройки по умолчанию. Однако, для эффективного использования компьютера ИТ-специалисту необходимы различные настройки.

1.1. Настройка параметров контроля учетных записей

Корпорация Microsoft сделала большой акцент на безопасности ПК с Windows в своих последних выпусках операционной системы. Один из способов повышения безопасности системы является эффективный контроль учетных записей. В Windows 10 имеется две начальных версии этой функции: «Высокий режим» и «Низкий режим». Настройки для контроля учетных записей могут быть настроены в разделе «Учетные записи» в панели управления.

1.2. Настройка службы просмотра событий Windows

События Windows — это записи в журнале, создаваемые системой, драйверами или приложением, которые сообщают об операциях, которые выполняются на ПК. ИТ-специалистам полезно знать серьезность и тип события для того, чтобы лучше понимать работу системы, их возможное воздействие на ее функциональность и способность решить проблему. Для просмотра журнала событий нужно перейти в «Компьютеры» → «Управление» → «Служба просмотра событий Windows».

Глава 2. Установка программного обеспечения

Во время установки софта на ПК необходимо знать настройки, которые нужно изменить, чтобы избежать конфликтов между приложениями.

2.1. Установка антивирусного ПО

Необходимо установить и настроить антивирусное ПО для защиты от вредоносного ПО, которые могут навредить как исправлению проблем, так и работе ПК в целом. Главным параметром, который должен быть настроен, является запланированное сканирование и обновление базы данных вирусов.

2.2. Установка Microsoft Office

Microsoft Office является популярным набором программного обеспечения, который включает Word, Excel, PowerPoint и другие программы, связанные с бизнес-приложениями. Также есть различные настройки, которые нужно изменить во время установки, например, настройки автоисправления, автозаполнения и сохранения настроек.

Глава 3. Интеграция ИТ-систем

3.1. Настройка сетевых соединений

Сетевые соединения нужны для обмена информацией между компьютерами в локальной сети. Настройка сетевых соединений обычно включает в себя указание адреса IP, маски подсети и адреса шлюза по умолчанию.

3.2. Настройка подключения к интернету

Прежде чем начать работать с новым ПК, необходимо подключить его к Интернету. Для этого нужно установить драйвера для сетевого адаптера и настроить интернет-соединение.

Заключение

ИТ-специалисты в организациях занимаются настройкой и поддержкой ПК и софта на них. Однако, установка и настройка ПК и программного обеспечения могут привести к конфликтам между приложениями и нежелательным настройкам ПК, что может повлиять на эффективность работы системы. Поэтому ИТ-специалисты должны иметь знания и навыки для правильной установки и конфигурирования рабочего места.
什么是生成式AI
生成式AI指的是基于深度学习的一类人工智能模型，借助于神经网络等技术能够自动生成图片、音乐、文本等内容。生成式AI的核心思想是利用模型已经学习到的模式和规律来创造新的样本。它不像传统的分类和回归模型那样需要输入样本具有固定的标签或值，而是自主地生成内容。可以用于诸如自然语言处理、图像和视频生成等领域。近年来，生成式AI已经得到广泛的应用，尤其是在艺术创意、设计和娱乐等领域。

技术报告 算法部分怎么写

技术报告的算法部分主要是介绍所设计或应用的算法，包括算法的原理、流程、优缺点等内容。下面是算法部分的具体写作步骤：

1. 算法原理

首先介绍算法的原理，包括算法的基本思路、核心概念、算法评估指标等内容，这样可以让读者对算法有一个初步的了解。

2. 算法流程

接着介绍算法的具体流程，包括输入、输出、计算过程、算法复杂度等等。可以结合图表等形式来展示算法的流程，让读者更直观地理解算法。

3. 算法优缺点

在介绍完算法的流程后，需要进一步分析算法的优缺点。对于优点，可以从计算速度、稳定性、效率等角度进行分析，让读者更加明确算法的优势。对于缺点，可以列举影响算法效果的因素，例如误差率、稳定性等，并提出改进措施，以便读者更好地理解算法的限制。

4. 算法应用

最后，需要将算法与实际应用相结合，具体介绍所设计或应用的算法的价值、可行性、特点等，以及算法在实际场景中的应用效果。这部分可以举例说明，让读者更好地理解算法在实践中的应用。

总体来说，算法部分应该具体全面、深入浅出，能使读者充分理解所设计或应用算法的基本原理和功能特点，同时也可以简洁明了、准确易懂，让读者更好地理解和接受算法。

Title: Timing Your Perfect Morocco Escapade: A Guide for Different Travelers

Introduction

Morocco has long been a favored destination for travelers worldwide. It presents a fascinating fusion of cultures, from the Mediterranean to the Sub-Saharan, with landscapes and festivities as diverse as its people. No two visitors will have the same trip, and knowing when to embark on your Moroccan adventure could make all the difference in creating your perfect experience. With that in mind, we've crafted this guide to help you determine the best time to visit Morocco according to your traveler type and preferences.

For the Culture Connoisseur

If immersing yourself in Morocco's vibrant culture is your top priority, then visiting during one of its captivating festivals should be on your itinerary. Each season brings a different event to life, giving you a chance to witness the cultural tapestry that Morocco is famous for.

1. Spring (March-May): The festival season kicks off with the International Nomads Festival, held every March in the desert oasis of M'Hamid El Ghizlane. Celebrating the nomadic heritage of the region, this makes for a unique, colorful, and music-filled experience.

2. Summer (June-August): The summertime showcases Morocco's love for music, featuring festivals like the Gnaoua World Music Festival in Essaouira or the Fes Festival of World Sacred Music. Visiting during these months allows you to take in two of Morocco's most scenic cities while enjoying an energy-packed celebration.

3. Fall (September-November): Among the cultural events that occur during autumn, the El Kelaâ des M’Gouna Rose Festival in May stands out. It attracts perfume connoisseurs from around the globe and showcases Morocco's lush flora and delicate rose harvest.

For the Adventure Seeker

Thrill-seekers have plenty of options when it comes to outdoor pursuits in Morocco. However, the adventure of choice and the ideal time for it will vary depending on your preference and the region you wish to explore.

1. Trekking: Morocco's stunningly diverse landscape offers hiking opportunities year-round. However, spring (April-May) and autumn (September-October) are the most favorable times due to cooler temperatures and panoramic views of snow-capped peaks and lush valleys.

2. Surfing: Morocco's Atlantic coast attracts water sports enthusiasts from around the world, with its impressive swells and beginner-friendly breaks. The most consistent surf conditions can be found between October and March.

3. Skiing: If hitting the slopes is your version of adventure, Morocco presents a unique and exotic ski destination. The season typically spans December to February, and the Atlas Mountains offer picturesque ski resorts like Oukaimeden and Michlifen.

For the Budget Traveler

Visiting Morocco off-peak allows for budget-conscious adventurers to enjoy more of the destination for a fraction of the cost. Opting for the shoulder seasons—spring (April-May) and autumn (October-November)—ensures a perfect balance of pleasant weather and budget-friendly options when it comes to accommodation and other amenities.

During these periods, you'll find that prices are more negotiable, meaning you can snag better deals on your riad or hotel stays, souvenir-shopping and even food experiences.

For the Weatherwise Wanderer

Morocco's geographic wonders present vastly different weather conditions depending on the region. Here's a brief guide to the weather patterns throughout the year:

1. Coastal Cities (Casablanca, Rabat, and Essaouira): Featuring a Mediterranean climate, these cities have mild winters and warm summers, making them enjoyable all-year-round.

2. Imperial Cities (Fes, Marrakech, and Meknes): Possessing a semi-arid climate, the temperature can soar during summertime, while winter months can be chilly, especially at night. Late spring and fall are the most comfortable seasons here.

3. Atlas Mountains: Trekking and skiing are weather-dependent adventures in the Atlas Mountains. Expect cold and snowy weather in winter and milder temperatures in the summer months.

4. Desert (Sahara): During the day, the region can experience blazing heat, whereas nighttime temperatures can be surprisingly cool year-round. The transitional seasons of spring and fall present the most predictable and pleasant climate.

Conclusion

Morocco's alluring combination of landscape, culture, and adventure caters to a wide array of traveler preferences. Each season brings its unique charm and appeal, making Morocco a fabulous destination at any moment of the year. This guide is a starting point to help you customize your Moroccan escapade, ensuring your trip is as unforgettable as it is personal. Happy travels!

3. 详细描述算法：这是算法部分的核心内容。根据算法的复杂度，可以采用不同的方法来描述：

   - 使用伪代码：为了方便读者理解算法的逻辑，可以使用伪代码来表示算法。伪代码是一种类似于编程语言的文字描述，可以清晰地表达算法的逻辑和结构。
   - 分步讲解：将整个算法分解为若干个步骤，并对每个步骤进行详细说明。使用图表和示例来解释算法的工作原理，这有助于读者更好地理解算法。
   - 数学公式：如果算法涉及到复杂数学计算，可以使用数学公式来表示。确保使用正确的数学符号，并对所有符号及其意义进行详细解释。

4. 复杂度分析：对算法的时间复杂度和空间复杂度进行分析，说明算法的效率和实际应用场景。这有助于读者了解算法的优缺点，以及在实际问题中可能遇到的挑战。

5. 示例和图表：使用具体的示例和图表来辅助算法的解释。这将使读者更容易理解算法的工作原理和实现过程，同时也能帮助检查算法的正确性。

6. 结果和性能评估：根据实验和应用数据，评估算法的实际表现和性能。报告应该详细描述评估过程、方法和数据来源，以确保结果的可靠性。

7. 结论：在算法部分的结尾，总结算法的主要优缺点，以及在实际场景中的应用前景。如果可能，还可以讨论未来改进算法的策略和方向。

总之，撰写技术报告的算法部分需要条理清晰、逻辑严密，并通过伪代码、示例和图表等手段使读者更容易理解算法的工作原理。同时，进行复杂度分析、结果评估和讨论未来改进方向，将有助于提高报告的质量和实用性。
